akhfash:3-3.t: He said: ﴿بِمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ﴾; he says ﴿نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ﴾ by Our revealing ﴿إِلَيْكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ﴾. He made (ما) a noun for the action [i.e. a maṣdar-forming mā] and made (أَوْحَيْنا) its ṣila (relative clause).

akhfash:4-4.t:
He said: ﴿إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِي سَاجِدِينَ﴾: He repeated the verb, though one of the two could suffice. This follows the dialect of those who say "ضَرَبْتُ زَيْداً ضَرَبْتُهُ" (I struck Zayd, I struck him), and it is emphasis (tawkīd), like ﴿فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةُ كُـلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ﴾. Some read (أَحَدَ عْشَرَ) with the ʿayn quiescent, and likewise (تِسْعَةَ عْشَرَ) and so on up to twenty: since the noun was long and had many vowelled letters, they made it quiescent. They did not make it quiescent in their saying "اثْنَيْ عَشَر" and "اثْنَتا عَشْرَةَ" because of the quiescent letter before the ʿayn. The vowelling of the ʿayn in all of this is the original.
As for His words ﴿رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِي سَاجِدِينَ﴾: since He made them like rational beings in prostrating and obeying, He made them like humans in using the masculine when He gave them the plural, just as He said ﴿عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ﴾. The poet said [in the khafīf metre, and it is the two hundred and thirty-third poetic witness]:
صَدَّها مَنْطِقُ الدَّجاجِ عَنِ القَصْدِ * وَضَرْبُ الناقُوسِ فَاجْتُنِبا
(The speech of the fowls and the striking of the church-bell turned her from her course, so both were avoided.)
And He said ﴿يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُواْ مَسَاكِنَكُمْ﴾ since an ant spoke and so became like a rational being. And He said ﴿فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ﴾: since He made them obey, He likened them to humans. Like that is ﴿قَالَتَآ أَتَيْنَا طَآئِعِينَ﴾ by this analogy, except that it is masculine while not being masculine, just as some feminines are made masculine. Some people said He said ﴿طائِعين﴾ only because the two came together with what is in them, so some imagined it "masculine"; or it may be as He said ﴿وَسْئَلِ ٱلْقَرْيَةَ﴾, meaning its people. And as you say "صَلى المَسْجِدُ" (the mosque prayed) meaning the people of the mosque, except that you construe the verb according to the latter [the omitted word], as they said: "اِجْتَمَعتْ أَهُلُ اليمامَةِ" (the people of al-Yamāma gathered). And He said ﴿وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ ٱللَّيْلُ وَٱلنَّهَارُ وَٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ لاَ تَسْجُدُواْ لِلشَّمْسِ وَلاَ لِلْقَمَرِ وَٱسْجُدُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَهُنَّ﴾, because a group of non-humans is feminine. Someone said it means "لِلَّذِي خَلَقَ الآياتِ" (to the One who created the signs), and I do not think he said that except out of ignorance of Arabic. The poet said [in the basīṭ metre, and it is the two hundred and thirty-fourth poetic witness]:
إِذْ أَشْرَفَ الديكُ يَدْعُوا بَعْضَ أُسْرَتِهِ * إِلى الصِياحِ وَهُمْ قُوْمٌ مُعَازِيلٌ
(When the cock rose up, calling some of his family to crow, and they are a people unarmed.)
So he made the fowls "a people" by the latitude of the language. Another said, meaning the wolf [in the ṭawīl metre, and it is the two hundred and thirty-second poetic witness]:
وَأَنْتَ امْرُؤٌ تَعْدُو عَلى كُلِّ غِرَّةٍ * فَتُخْطِىءُ فِيها مَرَّةً وَتَصِيُبُ
(You are a man who pounces on every unguarded moment, sometimes missing and sometimes hitting the mark.)
And another said [in the rajaz metre, and it is the two hundred and thirty-fifth poetic witness]:
فَصَبَّحَتْ وَالطَّيْرُ لَمْ تَكَلَّمِ * جابِيَةً طُمَّتْ بِسَيْلٍ مُفعَم
(She came at dawn, while the birds had not yet spoken, to a cistern brimming with a full torrent.)

akhfash:5-5.t: He said: ﴿فَيَكِيدُواْ لَكَ كَيْداً﴾, i.e. "so that they contrive a plot for you". It is not like ﴿إِن كُنتُمْ لِلرُّؤْيَا تَعْبُرُونَ﴾. He wanted to join the verb to it with the lām, as it is joined with "إلى" (to), as you say "قَدَّمْتُ لَهُ طَعاماً" (I set food before him), meaning "قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْهِ". And He said ﴿يَأْكُلْنَ مَا قَدَّمْتُمْ لَهُنَّ﴾; like it is ﴿قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يَهْدِي لِلْحَقِّ﴾. If you wish, ﴿فَيَكِيدُواْ لَكَ كَيْداً﴾ may have the meaning "فَيَكِيدوك" (so they plot against you), and you make the lām like ﴿لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ﴾; and His words ﴿لِرَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُونَ﴾ are only "لِمَكانِ رَبِّهِمْ يَرْهَبُون" (they fear on account of their Lord).

akhfash:9-9.t: He said: ﴿أَوِ ٱطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضاً يَخْلُ لَكُمْ﴾. "الأَرْضُ" (land) here is not an adverb (ẓarf); rather "في" (in) has been omitted from it and then the verb made to govern it, as you say "تَوَجَّهْتُ مَكَّةَ" (I headed Mecca).

akhfash:14-14.t: He said: ﴿وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ﴾. "العُصْبَةُ" and "العِصابَةُ" are a group that has no singular, like "القَوْم" (people) and "الرَّهْط" (band).

akhfash:18-18.t: He said: ﴿بِدَمٍ كَذِبٍ﴾: He made "the blood" a "lie" because a lie was told about it, as you say "الليلةُ الهِلالُ" (tonight is the new moon) with the nominative, and as He said ﴿فَمَا رَبِحَتْ تِّجَارَتُهُمْ﴾.

akhfash:19-19.t: He said: ﴿وَجَاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ فَأَرْسَلُواْ وَارِدَهُمْ﴾: He used the masculine after the feminine because "السَيَّارة" (the caravan) in meaning refers to men.

akhfash:23-23.t: He said: ﴿مَعَاذَ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُ رَبِّيۤ﴾, i.e. "I seek refuge in Allah, a seeking of refuge". He made it a substitute for pronouncing the verb, because it is a maṣdar, even though [the verb is] not in use, like "سُبْحانَ". Some say "مَعاذَةَ اللهِ", and say "ما أَحْسَنَ مَعْناةَ هَذا الكلامِ" (how fine is the meaning of this speech), meaning "المعنى".

akhfash:24-24.t: He said: ﴿وَهَمَّ بِهَا﴾: he did not intend the indecency, but something short of it which does not sever [his] standing as one of Allah's friends (al-walāya).

akhfash:25-25.t: He said: ﴿إِلاَّ أَن يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ﴾; he says "except prison or a painful punishment", because the light "أنْ" together with what it governs is a noun with the status of "السّجْن" (prison).

akhfash:32-32.t: He said: ﴿وَلَيَكُوناً مِّن ٱلصَّاغِرِينَ﴾: the pause on it is (وَلِيَكُونا), because when what precedes the light nūn (of emphasis) has fatḥa and you pause on it, you make it a quiescent alif, like your saying "رَأَيْتُ زيدا". Like it is ﴿لَنَسْفَعاً بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ﴾: the pause on it is "لَنَسْفَعا".

akhfash:35-35.t: He said: ﴿ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُمْ مِّن بَعْدِ مَا رَأَوُاْ ٱلآيَاتِ لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ﴾: he put the nūn (of emphasis) in this position because this is a position in which "أيّ" (which?) occurs; since the interrogative particle can enter here, the nūn entered it, because the nūn occurs in questions. You say "بدا لَهُم أَيُّهُم يأخذون" (it occurred to them which of them they would take), i.e. it became clear to them.

akhfash:44-44.t: He said: ﴿وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَأْوِيلِ ٱلأَحْلاَمِ بِعَالِمِينَ﴾: with one of the two bāʾs he joined the verb to the noun, and the other entered because of "ما" — and it is the latter.

akhfash:45-45.t: He said: ﴿وَٱذَّكَرَ بَعْدَ أُمَّةٍ﴾. It is "اِفْتَعَل" from "ذُكَرْتُ", so its origin is "اِذْتَكَر"; but the two [dhāl and tāʾ] came together in one word with close points of articulation, and they wanted to assimilate. The first is a voiced (majhūr) letter, and the first is merged only into the second, while the second is voiceless (mahmūs); they disliked that its voicing should be lost, so in place of the tāʾ they put a voiced letter from its own place of articulation, namely the dāl, because the letter before it is voiced. They did not use ṭāʾ because ṭāʾ, besides being voiced, is velarised (muṭbaq). Some said (مُذّكِر), changing the tāʾ into dhāl and then merging the dhāl into it. And this verse has been read ﴿أَن يُصْلِحَا بَيْنَهُمَا صُلْحاً﴾, and it is "أَنْ يَفْتَعِلا" from "الصُلْح": the tāʾ came after the ṣād, and the ṣād was not merged into it because of its voicing and velarisation, so they changed the tāʾ into ṣād [يَصَّالَحا]. [Translator's note: the quoted reading «يُصْلِحَا» is the one with no tāʾ; the discussion concerns the readings «يَصَّالَحَا/يَصَّلِحَا» and «يَصْطَلِحَا»; translated as written.] Some read (يَصْطَلِحا), and it is the good one: since the ṣād could not be assimilated into the tāʾ, a velarised letter was put in place of the tāʾ.

akhfash:51-51.t: He said: ﴿إِذْ رَاوَدتُنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِ﴾. Some of the people of knowledge said: "They [the women] solicited him, not the king's wife [alone]". It is also permissible, even if it was one woman, to say "راوَدْتُنَّ" (you [fem. pl.] solicited), just as you say (إِنَّ الناسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُم), where this is one person here: by His words "لَكُمْ" He means the Prophet — Allah bless him — and by (الناسَ) "Abū Sufyān", according to what they mentioned.

akhfash:76-76.t: He said: ﴿ثُمَّ ٱسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِن وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ﴾, using the feminine, and He said ﴿وَلِمَن جَآءَ بِهِ حِمْلُ بَعِيرٍ﴾, because there He meant "الصُّواع" (the measuring cup), and "الصُّواع" is masculine — though some make "الصّواع" feminine — and here He meant "السِّقَايَةَ" (the drinking cup), which is feminine. They are two names for one thing, like "الثَّوْبُ" and "المِلْحَفَةُ" (garment, wrap): masculine and feminine for one thing.

akhfash:80-80.t:
He said: ﴿خَلَصُواْ نَجِيّاً﴾: He made "النَجِيَّ" (confidant) apply to a group, like your saying "هُمْ لِي صديق" (they are a friend to me).
And He said ﴿قَالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ﴾: they claimed that he was the greatest of them in intelligence, not in age.

akhfash:83-83.t: He said ﴿عَسَى ٱللَّهُ أَن يَأْتِيَنِي بِهِمْ جَمِيعاً﴾ only because he meant the one who stayed behind, together with the two, and he was the greatest of them in intelligence.

akhfash:84-84.t: He said: ﴿يَٰأَسَفَىٰ عَلَى يُوسُفَ﴾: when you pause, you add hāʾ at its end, because it is like the alif of lamentation (alif al-nudba).

akhfash:85-85.t: He said: ﴿تَالله تَفْتَؤُاْ تَذْكُرُ يُوسُفَ﴾. They claimed that (تَفْتَأُ) means "تَزَالُ" (you continue); that is why the oath fell on it, as though they said: "By Allah, you do not cease remembering Yūsuf".

akhfash:92-92.t: He said: ﴿لاَ تَثْرِيبَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ﴾: (اليومَ) is a pause; then he began anew and said ﴿يَغْفِرُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ﴾, praying for forgiveness for them as a new sentence.

daas-irab:33-35.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the omitted first-person yāʾ; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿السِّجْنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَحَبُّ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿إِلَيَّ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أحب. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ مِن a preposition and ما a relative; the two are attached to أحب. ﴿يَدْعُونَنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil, the [second] nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to يدعونني. ﴿وَإِلَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, إن is conditional and لا is negating. ﴿تَصْرِفْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَنِّي﴾ the two are attached to تصرف. ﴿كَيْدَهُنَّ﴾ its mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct) and the nūn is the sign of the feminine plural; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَصْبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), its fāʿil latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition not joined with fāʾ. ﴿إِلَيْهِنَّ﴾ the two are attached to أصب. ﴿وَأَكُنْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, conjoined to what precedes and jussive like it; its noun (ism) is omitted. ﴿مِنَ الْجاهِلِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿فَاسْتَجابَ لَهُ رَبُّهُ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and a past verb and its fāʿil; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to استجاب; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَصَرَفَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction (ʿāṭifa), and a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ the two are attached to صرف. ﴿كَيْدَهُنَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi and the nūn is the sign of the feminine plural; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّهُ هُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ﴾ إنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun; هو is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl), and السميع and العليم are its two khabars. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿بَدا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif owing to impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to بدا. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to بدا. ﴿ما﴾ maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿رَأَوُا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; ما and what follows it are, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), in the position of a genitive (jarr) as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْآياتِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the kasra because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿لَيَسْجُنُنَّهُ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath; يسجننه is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis; the hāʾ is its mafʿūl, and the omitted wāw of the group is its fāʿil; the clause is the fāʿil of بدا. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of jarr. ﴿حِينٍ﴾ genitive (majrūr) by حتى; the two are attached to يسجننه.

daas-irab:36-37.t: ﴿وَدَخَلَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb. ﴿مَعَهُ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) دخل; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿السِّجْنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), placed first. ﴿فَتَيانِ﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the alif because it is a dual; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿قالَ أَحَدُهُما﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). [Translator's note: the source calls the same clause both conjoined and resumptive; translated as written.] ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿أَرانِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur); the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿أَعْصِرُ خَمْراً﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the second mafʿūl bihi of أراني. ﴿وَقالَ الْآخَرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنِّي أَرانِي﴾ إنّ and its noun; the clause أراني, whose i'rab has already been given, is the khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَحْمِلُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿فَوْقَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to أحمل. ﴿رَأْسِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خُبْزاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿تَأْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of خبز. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ the two are attached to تأكل or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿نَبِّئْنا﴾ an imperative verb and its mafʿūl, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿بِتَأْوِيلِهِ﴾ the two are attached to نبئنا. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿نَراكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the alif owing to impossibility; the kāf is its mafʿūl and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar of إنّ, and the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ the two are attached to نراك. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا يَأْتِيكُما طَعامٌ﴾ لا is negating; يأتيكما is an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal), and the kāf is its mafʿūl placed first. ﴿طَعامٌ﴾ fāʿil placed after; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿تُرْزَقانِهِ﴾ an imperfect verb, passive (mabnī lil-majhūl), nominative by the retention of the nūn; the alif is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is an adjective of طعام. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿نَبَّأْتُكُما﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil, the kāf its mafʿūl, and the mīm and alif are for the dual; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿بِتَأْوِيلِهِ﴾ the two are attached to نبأتكما. ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to نبأتكما. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle governing the accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿يَأْتِيكُما﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the kāf is its mafʿūl and its fāʿil is latent; أن and what follows it are, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿ذلِكُما﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance, the kāf for address, and the mīm and alif for the dual. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ مِن a preposition and ما a relative; the two are attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَّمَنِي رَبِّي﴾ a past verb; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is its mafʿūl placed first; ربي is the fāʿil and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَرَكْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿مِلَّةَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَوْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of قوم. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the two are attached to يؤمنون. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِالْآخِرَةِ﴾ the two are attached to كافرون. ﴿هُمْ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl). ﴿كافِرُونَ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:38-39.t: ﴿وَاتَّبَعْتُ مِلَّةَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿آبائِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ badal (substitute) for آبائي. ﴿وَإِسْحاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ﴾ conjoined to إبراهيم. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿لَنا﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle governing the accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿نُشْرِكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), its fāʿil latent (mustatir); أن and what follows it are, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), in the position of a nominative as the noun (ism) of كان. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ; the two are attached to نشرك. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿مِنْ فَضْلِ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ the two are attached to فضل. ﴿وَعَلَى النَّاسِ﴾ conjoined to علينا. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لكنّ and its noun. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَشْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لكنّ. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿صاحِبَيِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a dual; the nūn was dropped for the annexation; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿السِّجْنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَأَرْبابٌ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and mubtadaʾ. ﴿مُتَفَرِّقُونَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿أَمِ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, conjoined to أرباب. ﴿الْواحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ﴾ two adjectives of الله.

daas-irab:40-41.t: ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿تَعْبُدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَسْماءً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿سَمَّيْتُمُوها﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil (agent), the wāw is for vowel-lengthening (al-ishbāʿ), and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of أسماء. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) for the fāʿil of سميتموها, in the position of a nominative like it. ﴿وَآباؤُكُمْ﴾ conjoined to the tāʾ; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil. ﴿بِها﴾ the two are attached to أنزل; the clause is a second adjective of أسماء. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿سُلْطانٍ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿إِنِ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached to the omitted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَمَرَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿إِنِ﴾ a particle governing the accusative (nāṣiba). [Translator's note: the Quranic text here is أَلَّا (أن + لا); the source prints ﴿إِنِ﴾ but parses it as the accusative-governing أن.] ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَعْبُدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; and the wāw is [its] fāʿil. ﴿إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ﴾ إلا is a particle of restriction, and إياه is a detached pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, and أن and what follows it are in the position of a genitive by the omitted bāʾ; the two are attached to أمر. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ the demonstrative is mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿الدِّينُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الْقَيِّمُ﴾ an adjective. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لكنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿صاحِبَيِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a dual; the nūn was dropped for the annexation; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿السِّجْنِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَمَّا﴾ a particle of condition and detailing (tafṣīl). ﴿أَحَدُكُما﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَيَسْقِي﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the response to أمّا, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal), its fāʿil latent. ﴿رَبَّهُ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَمْراً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَمَّا﴾ a particle of detailing and condition. ﴿الْآخَرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَيُصْلَبُ﴾ the fāʾ occurs in the response to أمّا, and an imperfect passive verb (mabnī lil-majhūl); its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted; the clause is the khabar. [Translator's note: in standard parsing the nāʾib fāʿil here is a latent pronoun (mustatir); the source says "omitted" (maḥdhūf).] ﴿فَتَأْكُلُ الطَّيْرُ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ رَأْسِهِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قُضِيَ الْأَمْرُ﴾ a passive past verb and its nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, an adjective of الأمر. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to تستفتيان. ﴿تَسْتَفْتِيانِ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the alif is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:42-43.t: ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِلَّذِي﴾ a relative noun; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) قال. ﴿ظَنَّ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿أَنَّهُ﴾ أنّ and what follows it stand in place of the two objects of ظنّ. ﴿ناجٍ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of أنّ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the omitted yāʾ because it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ). ﴿مِنْهُمَا﴾ the two are attached to ناج. ﴿اذْكُرْنِي﴾ an imperative verb; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is its mafʿūl (object), and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān); the two are attached to اذكرني. ﴿رَبِّكَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَنْساهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied on the alif owing to impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur); the hāʾ is its first mafʿūl, placed first. ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ fāʿil placed after. ﴿ذِكْرَ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿فَلَبِثَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿فِي السِّجْنِ﴾ the two are attached to لبث. ﴿بِضْعَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to لبث. ﴿سِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَقالَ الْمَلِكُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the alif owing to impossibility, its fāʿil latent. ﴿سَبْعَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَقَراتٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of إني. ﴿سِمانٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿يَأْكُلُهُنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl placed first. ﴿سَبْعَ﴾ fāʿil placed after. ﴿عِجافٌ﴾ an adjective; the clause is the second mafʿūl bihi of أرى. ﴿وَسَبْعَ﴾ conjoined to the earlier سبع. ﴿سُنْبُلاتٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خُضْرٍ﴾ an adjective of سنبلات. ﴿وَأُخَرَ﴾ conjoined to سبع; it is genitive by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf). [Translator's note: the source says conjoined to سبع yet genitive; the genitive fits conjunction to سنبلات.] ﴿يابِساتٍ﴾ an adjective of أخر. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ أيّ is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), in the position of an accusative by the vocative; the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh). ﴿الْمَلَأُ﴾ badal (substitute) for أيّ, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿أَفْتُونِي﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause and what precedes it are the object of the saying. ﴿فِي رُءْيايَ﴾ the two are attached to أفتوني, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿لِلرُّءْيا﴾ the lām is a preposition and الرؤيا a genitive noun, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied on the alif owing to impossibility; the two are attached to تعبرون. ﴿تَعْبُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كنتم, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted.

daas-irab:44-46.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَضْغاثُ﴾ khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هي أضغاث"; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَحْلامٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and ما is negating, operating like ليس. ﴿نَحْنُ﴾ the noun (ism) of ما. ﴿بِتَأْوِيلِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) عالمين. ﴿الْأَحْلامِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِعالِمِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and عالمين is its khabar, genitive in form and nominative in position; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَقالَ الَّذِي﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَجا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur), its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿مِنْهُما﴾ the two are attached to نجا. ﴿وَادَّكَرَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, conjoined to نجا. ﴿بَعْدَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to ادكر. ﴿أُمَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أُنَبِّئُكُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb; the kāf is its mafʿūl (object) and its fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِتَأْوِيلِهِ﴾ the two are attached to أنبئكم, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَرْسِلُونِ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), and the omitted first-person yāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يُوسُفُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a single proper noun, with an omitted vocative particle; it is indeclinable on ḍamma in the position of an accusative, and its clause has no grammatical position. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ أيّ is the one addressed with an omitted vocative particle; it is indeclinable on ḍamma because it is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), in the position of an accusative; the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh). ﴿الصِّدِّيقُ﴾ badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); its clause has no grammatical position. ﴿أَفْتِنا﴾ an imperative verb and its mafʿūl, its fāʿil latent. ﴿فِي سَبْعِ﴾ the two are attached to أفتنا. ﴿بَقَراتٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سِمانٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of بقرات. ﴿يَأْكُلُهُنَّ سَبْعٌ عِجافٌ وَسَبْعِ سُنْبُلاتٍ خُضْرٍ وَأُخَرَ يابِساتٍ﴾ their i'rab has been given just above. ﴿لَعَلِّي﴾ لعلّ and its noun; the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿أَرْجِعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar. ﴿إِلَى النَّاسِ﴾ the two are attached to أرجع. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun; the mīm is for the masculine plural; the clause is a causal explanation with no grammatical position. ﴿يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لعلهم.

daas-irab:47-49.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿تَزْرَعُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿سَبْعَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) تزرعون. ﴿سِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿دَأَباً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and ما is a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) placed first. ﴿حَصَدْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; it is in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿فَذَرُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿فِي سُنْبُلِهِ﴾ the two are attached to ذروه; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, accusative (manṣūb). ﴿مِمَّا﴾ مِن a preposition and ما a relative in the position of a genitive; the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of قليلا. ﴿تَأْكُلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَأْتِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal). ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to يأتي. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿سَبْعٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿شِدادٌ﴾ an adjective. ﴿يَأْكُلْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is the fāʿil; the clause is a second adjective of سبع. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿قَدَّمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿لَهُنَّ﴾ the two are attached to قدمتم. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ excepted by إلا, accusative. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ مِن a preposition and ما a relative; the two are attached to an omitted adjective of قليلا. ﴿تُحْصِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿ثُمَّ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِ ذلِكَ﴾ its i'rab has been given just above. ﴿عامٌ﴾ the fāʿil of يأتي. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ the two are attached to يغاث. ﴿يُغاثُ النَّاسُ﴾ an imperfect passive verb (mabnī lil-majhūl) and nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is an adjective of عام. ﴿وَفِيهِ يَعْصِرُونَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يعصرون. ﴿يَعْصِرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what precedes it.

daas-irab:50-51.t: ﴿وَقالَ الْمَلِكُ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded. ﴿ائْتُونِي﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya), the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"), attached to جاءه. ﴿جاءَهُ الرَّسُولُ﴾ a past verb, a mafʿūl bihi placed first and a fāʿil placed after; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿قالَ ارْجِعْ إِلى رَبِّكَ﴾ the clause ارجع, made up of the imperative verb and its implicit (muḍmar) fāʿil, is the object of the saying. ﴿إِلى رَبِّكَ﴾ the two are attached to the verb ارجع. ﴿فَسْئَلْهُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb and its implicit fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to the clause ارجع. ﴿ما بالُ﴾ ما is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and بال is its khabar (predicate). ﴿النِّسْوَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿اللَّاتِي﴾ a relative noun in the position of a genitive as an adjective (ṣifa); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿قَطَّعْنَ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is the fāʿil. ﴿أَيْدِيَهُنَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ إنّ is a particle resembling the verb, ربي is its noun (ism), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِكَيْدِهِنَّ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿قالَ ما خَطْبُكُنَّ﴾ ما is interrogative, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ, and خطبكن is khabar. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to خطبكن. ﴿راوَدْتُنَّ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and its fāʿil. ﴿يُوسُفَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَنْ نَفْسِهِ﴾ the two are attached to راودتن. ﴿قُلْنَ﴾ a past verb, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil. ﴿حاشَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the lām; the two are attached to حاشا. ﴿ما عَلِمْنا﴾ ما is negating, and علمنا is a past verb and fāʿil. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to علمنا. ﴿مِنْ سُوءٍ﴾ مِن is a redundant (zāʾid) preposition, and سوء is genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi of علمنا. ﴿قالَتِ امْرَأَةُ الْعَزِيزِ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿الْآنَ﴾ an adverb of time attached to حصحص. ﴿حَصْحَصَ الْحَقُّ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿راوَدْتُهُ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَنْ نَفْسِهِ﴾ the two are attached to راودته. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إنّ [and] its noun. ﴿لَمِنَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and a preposition. ﴿الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ a genitive noun; the two are attached to the khabar.

daas-irab:52-52.t: ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿لِيَعْلَمَ﴾ the lām is causal (lil-taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the causal lām; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿أَنِّي﴾ أنّ and its noun (ism), standing in place of the two objects of يعلم. ﴿لَمْ أَخُنْهُ﴾ the clause is the khabar. ﴿بِالْغَيْبِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent). ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and أنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿لا يَهْدِي﴾ the clause is the khabar. ﴿كَيْدَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْخائِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ.

daas-irab:53-53.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause) and ما is negating. ﴿أُبَرِّئُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿نَفْسِي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّ النَّفْسَ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿لَأَمَّارَةٌ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and أمارة is khabar (predicate). ﴿بِالسُّوءِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أمارة. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, in the position of an accusative by exception. ﴿رَحِمَ رَبِّي﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ two khabars of إنّ; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).

daas-irab:54-57.t: ﴿وَقالَ الْمَلِكُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿ائْتُونِي﴾ an imperative verb; the wāw is its fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes. ﴿أَسْتَخْلِصْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) as the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لِنَفْسِي﴾ the two are attached to أستخلصه. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and لمّا is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"). ﴿كَلَّمَهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿قالَ إِنَّكَ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿لَدَيْنا﴾ لدي is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; attached to مكين. ﴿مَكِينٌ أَمِينٌ﴾ two khabars (predicates) of إنّ; the clause إنك etc. is in the position of an accusative as the object of the saying. ﴿قالَ اجْعَلْنِي﴾ اجعلني is an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of the saying. ﴿عَلى خَزائِنِ﴾ the two are attached to what precedes them. ﴿الْأَرْضِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنِّي حَفِيظٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, and the yāʾ is its noun, and حفيظ and عليم are its two khabars; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ [the wāw is] resumptive; كذلك: the kāf is a preposition, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive by the kāf; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "ذلك التمكين مكنا ليوسف". ﴿مَكَّنَّا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and نا is its fāʿil. ﴿لِيُوسُفَ﴾ the lām is a preposition; يوسف is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf); the two are attached to مكنا. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to مكنا. ﴿يَتَبَوَّأُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿مِنْها﴾ the two are attached to the verb; the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial), coming after a definite noun. ﴿حَيْثُ﴾ an adverb of place attached to يتبوأ. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil omitted; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نُصِيبُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. [Translator's note: the source does not parse the words برحمتنا من نشاء that follow نصيب in the verse.] ﴿وَلا نُضِيعُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating, and the imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿أَجْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿وَلَأَجْرُ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl, and the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and أجر is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ the lām is a preposition, and a relative noun in the genitive; the two are attached to خير. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿وَ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is conjoined. ﴿يَتَّقُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of كانوا.

daas-irab:58-60.t: ﴿وَجاءَ إِخْوَةُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa) with no grammatical position. ﴿يُوسُفَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf). ﴿فَدَخَلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). [Translator's note: دخلوا is a past verb; the source says "imperfect".] ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) دخلوا. ﴿فَعَرَفَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause), and هم is a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to منكرون. ﴿مُنْكِرُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ a conjunction, and an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) meaning "when". ﴿جَهَّزَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl, its fāʿil latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِجَهازِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to جهزهم. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿ائْتُونِي﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿بِأَخٍ﴾ the two are attached to ائتوني. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أخ. ﴿مِنْ أَبِيكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted second adjective. ﴿أَلا﴾ a particle drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿تَرَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿أَنِّي﴾ أنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿أُوفِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal), its fāʿil latent. ﴿الْكَيْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of أنّ, and the clause of أنّ stands in place of the two objects of ترون. ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl, and mubtadaʾ. ﴿خَيْرُ﴾ khabar; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿الْمُنْزِلِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ. ﴿فَإِنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) and إن is conditional. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a particle of negation, of the jussive (jazm) and of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] (qalb). ﴿تَأْتُونِي﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position because it is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to تأتوني. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿كَيْلَ﴾ its noun. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar of لا. ﴿عِنْدِي﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿تَقْرَبُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and the omitted yāʾ is its mafʿūl; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:61-62.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿سَنُراوِدُ﴾ the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿أَباهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause), and إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿لَفاعِلُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa) and the khabar (predicate) of إنّ; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿لِفِتْيانِهِ﴾ the two are attached to قال, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿اجْعَلُوا بِضاعَتَهُمْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فِي رِحالِهِمْ﴾ in the place of its second mafʿūl. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ﴾ لعلّ and its noun. ﴿يَعْرِفُونَها﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is the khabar of لعلّ. ﴿إِذَا﴾ an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive [as muḍāf ilayhi] and made accusative by its apodosis. ﴿انْقَلَبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلى أَهْلِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to انقلبوا. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ﴾ لعلّ and its noun; the clause is the khabar.

daas-irab:63-65.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"). ﴿رَجَعُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿إِلى أَبِيهِمْ﴾ إلى is a preposition; أبي is a genitive noun, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is one of the Five Nouns; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) رجعوا; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾ vocative. ﴿أَبانا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مُنِعَ﴾ a passive past verb (mabnī lil-majhūl). ﴿مِنَّا﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿الْكَيْلُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is like the one before it. ﴿فَأَرْسِلْ﴾ the fāʾ is the explanatory fāʾ (al-faṣīḥa); the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis of a condition that does not govern the jussive. ﴿مَعَنا﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to the verb, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَخانا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَكْتَلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause), and إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar (predicate). ﴿لَحافِظُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and حافظون is khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿قالَ هَلْ آمَنُكُمْ﴾ هل is an interrogative particle, and آمنكم is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, and the kāf is its mafʿūl; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to آمنكم. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a particle of comparison and ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿أَمِنْتُكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the kāf is its mafʿūl. ﴿عَلى أَخِيهِ﴾ على is a preposition, and أخيه is genitive by the yāʾ because it is one of the Five Nouns; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the two are attached to أمنتكم. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ قبل is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of a genitive; it was made indeclinable on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning; the two are attached to أمنتكم; and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of a genitive. ﴿فَاللَّهُ خَيْرٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and خير is khabar; the fāʾ is the explanatory fāʾ. ﴿حافِظاً﴾ tamyīz (specification); the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis of a condition that does not govern the jussive, the implied sense being "فإذا كان لا بد من إرساله فالله خير حافظا" (if his being sent is unavoidable, then Allah is the best guardian). It was also read خير حفظا and خير حافظ. ﴿وَهُوَ أَرْحَمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, by the yāʾ. ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and لمّا is temporal. ﴿فَتَحُوا مَتاعَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi, its position being genitive. ﴿وَجَدُوا بِضاعَتَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to the non-jussive لمّا. ﴿رُدَّتْ﴾ a passive past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the nāʾib fāʿil is a latent pronoun; the clause is in the position of an accusative as the second mafʿūl of وجدوا. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to ردت. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يا﴾ for the vocative. ﴿أَبانا﴾ the one addressed, a muḍāf, accusative by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿نَبْغِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal); the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "نحن". ﴿هذِهِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh), and ذه is a demonstrative in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِضاعَتُنا﴾ khabar, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying, or resumptive. ﴿رُدَّتْ﴾ a passive past verb; the nāʾib fāʿil is latent and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿إِلَيْنا﴾ the two are attached to ردت; the clause is a ḥāl or resumptive. ﴿وَنَمِيرُ أَهْلَنا﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined to an omitted clause, i.e. "لنستعين بها ونمير" (so that we may make use of it and bring provisions). ﴿وَنَحْفَظُ أَخانا﴾ the clause is conjoined, and its i'rab is like the one before it. ﴿وَنَزْدادُ كَيْلَ﴾ its i'rab is like the one before it. ﴿بَعِيرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿كَيْلَ﴾ its khabar. ﴿يَسِيرٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of كيل; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:66-67.t: ﴿قالَ لَنْ﴾ لن is a particle governing the accusative (nāṣib). ﴿أُرْسِلَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), and its mafʿūl (object), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of jarr. ﴿تُؤْتُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after حتى, by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil, the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مَوْثِقاً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by مِن; the two are attached to موثقا or to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of موثقا; أن and what follows it are, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), in the position of a genitive by حتى. ﴿لَتَأْتُنَّنِي﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which was dropped out of dislike for a succession of like letters; the omitted wāw of the group is the fāʿil, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters; the nūn is for emphasis and the last nūn is for protection, and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause occurs as the response to an omitted oath. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle governing the accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿يُحاطَ﴾ an imperfect passive verb (mabnī lil-majhūl); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يحاط. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"), an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿آتَوْهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl. ﴿مَوْثِقَهُمْ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to لمّا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿عَلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of a genitive by على; the two are attached to وكيل. ﴿نَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent; the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَكِيلٌ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the clause is conjoined or resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿بَنِيَّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative by the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive (nāhiya). ﴿تَدْخُلُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿مِنْ بابٍ﴾ the two are attached to تدخلوا. ﴿واحِدٍ﴾ an adjective of باب. ﴿وَادْخُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ أَبْوابٍ﴾ the two are attached to ادخلوا. ﴿مُتَفَرِّقَةٍ﴾ an adjective of أبواب. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause) and ما is negating. ﴿أُغْنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal), its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to أغني. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by مِن; the two are attached to a ḥāl of شيء. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ a noun, genitive in form and accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi of the verb أغني; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿إِنِ﴾ negating. ﴿الْحُكْمُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by the lām; the two are attached to the khabar. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to توكلت. ﴿تَوَكَّلْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَعَلَيْهِ﴾ conjoined to the preceding clause. ﴿فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), the lām is the lām of command, and يتوكل is an imperfect verb, jussive. ﴿الْمُتَوَكِّلُونَ﴾ fāʿil, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the object of the saying.

daas-irab:68-69.t: ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لمّا is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"). ﴿دَخَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), and the لمّا clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded. ﴿مِنْ حَيْثُ﴾ مِن is a preposition and حيث an adverb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of a genitive; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) دخلوا. ﴿أَمَرَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿أَبُوهُمْ﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw because it is one of the Five Nouns, and هم is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كانَ﴾ defective (nāqiṣa); its noun (ism) is omitted, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the entering. ﴿يُغْنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal); its fāʿil is omitted, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the entering; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يغني. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by مِن; the two are attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant (zāʾid) preposition. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ genitive in form and accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of disjunctive exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ) meaning "but" (لكن). ﴿حاجَةً﴾ excepted (mustathnā) by إلا, or mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿فِي نَفْسِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of حاجة. ﴿يَعْقُوبَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf). ﴿قَضاها﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif owing to impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur), its fāʿil latent (mustatir), and ها is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَإِنَّهُ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl, and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَذُو﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ذو is khabar, nominative by the wāw because it is one of the Five Nouns. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿لَمَّا﴾ the lām is a preposition and ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿عَلَّمْناهُ﴾ a past verb, fāʿil and its first mafʿūl; the second mafʿūl is omitted, its implied form being "إياه"; the clause, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), is genitive by the lām, and the two are attached to علم. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl, and لكنّ and its noun; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar of لكنّ. ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لمّا is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿دَخَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause دخلوا is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى يُوسُفَ﴾ the two are attached to دخلوا. ﴿آوى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif owing to impossibility; the fāʿil is latent; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to آوى. ﴿أَخاهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿أَنَا﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿أَخُوكَ﴾ khabar, nominative by the wāw because it is one of the Five Nouns, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the khabar of إنّ, and the clause of إنّ with its noun and khabar is the mafʿūl bihi of قال. ﴿فَلا﴾ the fāʾ is the explanatory fāʾ (al-faṣīḥa). ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive (nāhiya). ﴿تَبْتَئِسْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not govern the jussive. ﴿بِما﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and ما a relative; the two are attached to تبتئس. ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the clause is the khabar of كان.

daas-irab:70-72.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and لمّا is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"). ﴿جَهَّزَهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is a ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book makes the clause after لمّا the muḍāf ilayhi.] ﴿بِجَهازِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) جهزهم. ﴿جَعَلَ السِّقايَةَ﴾ a past verb and its first mafʿūl, its fāʿil latent. السقاية is a vessel in which grain is measured; it is also the صواع. ﴿فِي رَحْلِ﴾ the two are attached to جعل and stand in the place of the second mafʿūl. ﴿أَخِيهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is one of the Five Nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause جعل has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not govern the jussive. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿أَذَّنَ مُؤَذِّنٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَيَّتُهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted particle; it is an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of an accusative; the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh). ﴿الْعِيرُ﴾ badal (substitute), nominative, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of أذّن in the sense of "called out". ﴿إِنَّكُمْ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿لَسارِقُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and سارقون is khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is mafʿūl bihi of أذّن. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَأَقْبَلُوا﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause), and a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to أقبلوا. ﴿ماذا﴾ [ما is] an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and ذا is a relative, khabar. ﴿تَفْقِدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative, with no grammatical position. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿نَفْقِدُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent. ﴿صُواعَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْمَلِكِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿وَلِمَنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām a preposition and مَن a relative; the two are attached to an omitted khabar placed first. ﴿جاءَ﴾ the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to جاء. ﴿حِمْلُ﴾ mubtadaʾ placed after; the clause لمن etc. is conjoined. ﴿بَعِيرٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَنَا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and أنا is mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِهِ﴾ the two are attached to زعيم. ﴿زَعِيمٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:73-75.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿تَاللَّهِ﴾ the tāʾ is for the oath; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb of the oath; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿عَلِمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the response to an oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿جِئْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause stands in place of the two objects of علمتم. ﴿لِنُفْسِدَ﴾ the lām is causal (lil-taʿlīl), and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an implicit أن after the causal lām. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to نفسد; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of a genitive by the preposition, and the two are attached to جئنا. ﴿وَما﴾ ما is negating. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun (ism). ﴿سارِقِينَ﴾ khabar (predicate), accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَما﴾ the fāʾ is the explanatory fāʾ (al-faṣīḥa), disclosing an implied condition indicated by what follows it; ما is an interrogative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿جَزاؤُهُ﴾ khabar, and the hāʾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنْ﴾ governing the jussive, putting two verbs in the jussive. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ كان and its noun, and the mīm is for the plural; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿كاذِبِينَ﴾ the khabar of كان, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: "إن كنتم كاذبين فما جزاؤه؟" (if you are lying, then what is its penalty?). ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is initial. ﴿جَزاؤُهُ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative or conditional, in the position of a nominative as khabar; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وُجِدَ﴾ a passive past verb (mabnī lil-majhūl); the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is omitted. ﴿فِي رَحْلِهِ﴾ the two are attached to وجد; the clause has no grammatical position because it is a ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فَهُوَ﴾ the fāʾ is linking if we take مَن as a conditional noun governing the jussive, and هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿جَزاؤُهُ﴾ its khabar; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis if we take مَن as conditional. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition, and ذا a demonstrative in the position of a genitive by the kāf; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address; the two are attached to an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its implied form being "جزاء كذلك". ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿الظَّالِمِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

daas-irab:76-76.t: ﴿فَبَدَأَ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and بدأ is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) بدأ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿قَبْلَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) or to the verb before it. ﴿وِعاءِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَخِيهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is one of the Five Nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اسْتَخْرَجَها﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded. ﴿مِنْ وِعاءِ﴾ the two are attached to استخرجها. ﴿أَخِيهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the bāʾ because it is one of the Five Nouns. [Translator's note: "by the bāʾ" is evidently a slip for "by the yāʾ", as in the first occurrence above.] ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is for comparison and jarr, and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive by the kāf; the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿كِدْنا﴾ a complete (tāmm) past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِيُوسُفَ﴾ the lām is a preposition, and يوسف is genitive by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf); the two are attached to كدنا. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كانَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; its noun (ism) is omitted, its implied form being "هو". ﴿لِيَأْخُذَ﴾ the lām is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd), and the imperfect verb is accusative (manṣūb) by an أن that is necessarily implicit after the lām of denial; the fāʿil is latent; the clause, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) together with the lām, is attached to an omitted khabar (predicate) of كان. ﴿أَخاهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فِي دِينِ﴾ the two are attached to يأخذ. ﴿الْمَلِكِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle governing the accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿يَشاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative, and the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil; أن and what follows it are, as an interpreted maṣdar, genitive by an omitted preposition, and the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿نَرْفَعُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil latent. ﴿دَرَجاتٍ﴾ an adverb, accusative by the kasra in place of the fatḥa because it is a sound feminine plural. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). [Translator's note: the source prints the word as ﴿مِنْ﴾; the Quranic word is مَنْ, the relative.] ﴿نَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَفَوْقَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and فوق is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to the khabar placed first. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿ذِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ because it is one of the Five Nouns. ﴿عِلْمٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:77-78.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle governing the jussive. ﴿يَسْرِقْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) with no grammatical position, because it is the clause of a non-adverbial condition. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿سَرَقَ أَخٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of أخ. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the two are attached to سرق. ﴿فَأَسَرَّها﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿يُوسُفُ﴾ fāʿil placed after; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿وَلَمْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لم is a particle of the jussive, of negation and of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] (qalb). ﴿يُبْدِها﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; ها is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the fāʿil is omitted. ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يبدها; the clause is conjoined. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْتُمْ شَرٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿مَكاناً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause); the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ and أعلم is khabar; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿بِما﴾ ما is a relative; the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿تَصِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ for the vocative. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma; the clause is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an implied أدعو ("I call"); the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh). ﴿الْعَزِيزُ﴾ badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar. ﴿أَباً﴾ the noun (ism) of إنّ, accusative (manṣūb) by the overt fatḥa. ﴿شَيْخاً﴾ an adjective. ﴿كَبِيراً﴾ a second adjective. ﴿فَخُذْ﴾ the fāʾ is the explanatory fāʾ (al-faṣīḥa), and an imperative verb and a latent fāʿil. ﴿أَحَدَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is the apodosis of a condition that does not govern the jussive, with no grammatical position. ﴿مَكانَهُ﴾ an adverb attached to خذ, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿نَراكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the implied (muqaddara) ḍamma; the fāʿil is latent and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿مِنَ الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ the two are attached to نراك.

daas-irab:79-80.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿مَعاذَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle governing the accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿نَأْخُذَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of أن and what follows it is in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition (bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ); the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) معاذ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَجَدْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مَتاعَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِنْدَهُ﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to وجدنا, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of response and requital (jawāb wa-jazāʾ). ﴿لَظالِمُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and ظالمون is khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and لمّا is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"). ﴿اسْتَيْأَسُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿خَلَصُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the response to لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿نَجِيًّا﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw of خلصوا. ﴿قالَ كَبِيرُهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and لم governs the jussive. ﴿تَعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿أَنَّ أَباكُمْ﴾ أنّ and its noun, accusative by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi; the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of تعلموا. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿أَخَذَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to أخذ. ﴿مَوْثِقاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by مِن; the two are attached to موثقا. ﴿وَمِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl; قبل is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning; the two are attached to فرطتم. ﴿ما﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿فَرَّطْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي يُوسُفَ﴾ the two are attached to فرطتم; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿فَلَنْ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive; لن. ﴿أَبْرَحَ﴾ the imperfect verb, accusative by لن with the fatḥa, its fāʿil latent. ﴿الْأَرْضَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of jarr. ﴿يَأْذَنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative. ﴿لِي﴾ the two are attached to يأذن. ﴿أَبِي﴾ fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to يأذن. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl, and هو is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿خَيْرُ﴾ khabar; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿الْحاكِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:81-82.t: ﴿ارْجِعُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلى أَبِيكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ارجعوا; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَقُولُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and قولوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿يا﴾ vocative. ﴿أَبانا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿إِنَّ ابْنَكَ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿سَرَقَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿شَهِدْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿بِما﴾ ما is a relative; the two are attached to شهدنا. ﴿عَلِمْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حافِظِينَ﴾ كان, its noun, and its khabar, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; للغيب: the two are attached to the khabar; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَسْئَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent, and القرية is its mafʿūl (object). ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, an adjective (ṣifa) of القرية; the clause is conjoined. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَالْعِيرَ﴾ conjoined to القرية. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, an adjective of العير. ﴿أَقْبَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. ﴿فِيها﴾ the two are attached to أقبلنا. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause), and إنّ and its noun. ﴿لَصادِقُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the khabar of إنّ, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is a ḥāl. Asking the town means [asking] its inhabitants, and asking the caravan (العير, the camels) means [asking] the men of the caravan; in the expression there is a synecdochic trope (majāz mursal).

daas-irab:83-85.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ a resumptive (mustaʾnafa) clause. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنْفُسُكُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); لكم: the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) سولت; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿أَمْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction; صبر is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "صبري", and جميل is an adjective (ṣifa) of صبر; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿عَسَى﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, one of the verbs of hope. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun (ism). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle governing the accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿يَأْتِيَنِي﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to يأتيني; the clause is the khabar of عسى. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾ the separating pronoun (ḍamīr al-faṣl). ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ the khabar of إنّ. ﴿الْحَكِيمُ﴾ a second khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَتَوَلَّى﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and تولى is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur), its fāʿil latent (mustatir). [Translator's note: تولّى here is a past verb; the source says "imperfect".] ﴿عَنْهُمْ﴾ the two are attached to تولى. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَسَفى﴾ the one addressed (munādā), annexed to the first-person yāʾ, which has been turned into an alif with the letter before it given fatḥa; the implied form is "يا أسفي"; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَلى يُوسُفَ﴾ the two are attached to أسفا. ﴿وَابْيَضَّتْ عَيْناهُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative by the alif because it is a dual, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَ الْحُزْنِ﴾ the two are attached to ابيضت; the clause is conjoined by the wāw. ﴿فَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَاللَّهِ﴾ the tāʾ is for the oath and jarr; the two are attached to the verb أقسم ("I swear"); the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿تَفْتَؤُا﴾ a defective imperfect verb; its noun is omitted, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿تَذْكُرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar of تفتأ. ﴿يُوسُفَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya) and of jarr. ﴿تَكُونَ﴾ a defective imperfect verb, accusative by an implicit أن after حتى; its noun is omitted, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿حَرَضاً﴾ the khabar of تكون; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) made of أن and what follows it is in the position of a genitive by حتى, and the two are attached to the verb before them. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تَكُونَ﴾ a defective imperfect verb; its noun is latent. ﴿مِنَ الْهالِكِينَ﴾ the two are attached to the khabar; the clause is conjoined by أو.

daas-irab:86-87.t:
[Translator's note: in the source the opening of this entry is damaged — the bracketed Quranic words are cut off at the start (e.g. «الَ»» for قال, «ِنَّما»» for إنما). The words are restored below from the verse in ﴿…﴾; the analysis is translated as written.]
﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِنَّما﴾ [إنّ] made inoperative and [ما] making it inoperative (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿أَشْكُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the wāw owing to heaviness (al-thiqal);
