the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "أنا". ﴿بَثِّي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa implied on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel suited [to the yāʾ]; the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi of قال. ﴿وَحُزْنِي﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to بثي, its i'rab being like it. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by إلى; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb أشكو. ﴿وَأَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by مِن; the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿ما﴾ a relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿بَنِيَّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative by the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural; the nūn was dropped for the annexation; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿اذْهَبُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿فَتَحَسَّسُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ يُوسُفَ﴾ يوسف is genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf); the two are attached to تحسسوا. ﴿وَأَخِيهِ﴾ conjoined to يوسف and genitive like it, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is one of the Five Nouns; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is prohibitive (nāhiya). ﴿تَيْأَسُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿مِنْ رَوْحِ﴾ the two are attached to تيأسوا; الرَّوح means relief. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿لا يَيْأَسُ﴾ لا is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative by the overt ḍamma. ﴿مِنْ رَوْحِ﴾ the two are attached to ييأس. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿الْقَوْمُ﴾ fāʿil placed after. ﴿الْكافِرُونَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of القوم, nominative like it, by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنه, and the clause إنّ etc. is a causal explanation (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:88-89.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and لمّا is a conditional not governing the jussive. ﴿دَخَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) دخلوا; the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يا﴾ vocative. ﴿أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an implied أدعو ("I call"); the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿الْعَزِيزُ﴾ badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿مَسَّنا﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿وَأَهْلَنَا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the mafʿūl of مسّ and accusative like it; نا is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿الضُّرُّ﴾ the fāʿil of مسّ; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَجِئْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to what preceded. ﴿بِبِضاعَةٍ﴾ the two are attached to جئنا. ﴿مُزْجاةٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of بضاعة. ﴿فَأَوْفِ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil latent (mustatir). ﴿لَنَا﴾ the two are attached to أوف; the clause is conjoined by the fāʾ. ﴿الْكَيْلَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَتَصَدَّقْ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to أوف and jussive (majzūm) like it, its fāʿil latent. [Translator's note: تصدّق here is an imperative; the source says "imperfect … jussive".] ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ the two are attached to تصدق. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun (ism); the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿يَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (al-thiqal), its fāʿil latent. ﴿الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause يجزي is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, in the position of a nominative. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿هَلْ﴾ an interrogative particle. ﴿عَلِمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَعَلْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿بِيُوسُفَ﴾ the two are attached to فعلتم; يوسف is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf), accusative in form and genitive in position. [Translator's note: so in the source; elsewhere the book says such a diptote is genitive by the fatḥa in place of the kasra.] ﴿وَأَخِيهِ﴾ conjoined to يوسف and genitive like it, by the yāʾ because it is one of the Five Nouns; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to فعلتم. ﴿أَنْتُمْ جاهِلُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar; the clause is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:90-92.t: ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَإِنَّكَ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and إنّ and its noun (ism); its clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَأَنْتَ يُوسُفُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنَا يُوسُفُ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿وَهذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh); ذا is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَخِي﴾ khabar, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿مَنَّ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) منّ. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿مَنَّ﴾ a conditional noun governing the jussive, mubtadaʾ. [Translator's note: the source prints the word as ﴿مَنَّ﴾; the Quranic word here is the conditional مَنْ.] ﴿يَتَّقِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), by the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿وَيَصْبِرْ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "هو"; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and إنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the clause is in the position of a jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause of the protasis and its apodosis is the khabar of مَن. ﴿لا يُضِيعُ﴾ لا is negating; يضيع is an imperfect verb, nominative, its fāʿil latent, its implied form being "هو". ﴿أَجْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the khabar of إنه. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَاللَّهِ﴾ the tāʾ is a particle of jarr and oath; the oath clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to the oath, and قد is a particle of realisation. ﴿آثَرَكَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb; the kāf is its mafʿūl placed first and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil placed after. ﴿عَلَيْنا﴾ the two are attached to آثرك; the clause occurs as the response to the oath, with no grammatical position. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إن is lightened from إنّ, its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn). ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the khabar of إن. ﴿لَخاطِئِينَ﴾ the shifted lām, and خاطئين is the khabar of كان, accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا تَثْرِيبَ﴾ لا is the lā of generic negation and تثريب is its noun; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿عَلَيْكُمُ﴾ the two are attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. [Translator's note: so in the source; the clause يغفر الله لكم is ordinarily taken as resumptive or as a prayer.] ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to يغفر. ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause); هو is mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَرْحَمُ﴾ khabar. ﴿الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:93-95.t: ﴿اذْهَبُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿بِقَمِيصِي﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) اذهبوا. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of a genitive as badal (substitute), adjective (ṣifa) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). ﴿فَأَلْقُوهُ﴾ the fāʾ is for conjunction, and an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿عَلى وَجْهِ﴾ the two are attached to ألقوه. ﴿أَبِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the kasra implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَأْتِ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the apodosis of an implied condition. ﴿بَصِيراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative. ﴿وَأْتُونِي﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِأَهْلِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to ائتوني; the kāf is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَجْمَعِينَ﴾ tawkīd (emphasis), genitive by the yāʾ. ﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and لمّا is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"), an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿فَصَلَتِ الْعِيرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the tāʾ is for the feminine; the clause is resumptive. ﴿قالَ أَبُوهُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw because it is one of the Five Nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position because it occurs as the apodosis of a condition that does not govern the jussive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَأَجِدُ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and an imperfect verb, nominative; the clause is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and its fāʿil is latent. ﴿رِيحَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يُوسُفَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf). ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a conditional particle not governing the jussive. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle governing the accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿تُفَنِّدُونِ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the omitted yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the clause after لولا is, as an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the khabar is omitted, the implied sense being "لولا تفنيدكم موجود لصدقتموني" (were it not for your calling me senile, you would believe me). ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿تَاللَّهِ﴾ the tāʾ is a particle of jarr and oath; the two are attached to the omitted verb of the oath, and its clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنَّكَ﴾ إنّ and its noun; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to the oath. ﴿لَفِي ضَلالِكَ﴾ the shifted lām; the two are attached to the omitted khabar, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الْقَدِيمِ﴾ an adjective, genitive.

daas-irab:96-97.t: ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and لمّا is temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"), an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿أَنْ﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿جاءَ الْبَشِيرُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿أَلْقاهُ﴾ a past verb; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is the response to لمّا, with no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى وَجْهِهِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ألقاه, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَارْتَدَّ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil latent. ﴿بَصِيراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa), with no grammatical position. ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for reproachful interrogation, and لم governs the jussive. ﴿أَقُلْ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to أقل. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism). ﴿أَعْلَمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by مِن; the two are attached to أعلم. ﴿ما﴾ a relative in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿تَعْلَمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ﴿قالُوا﴾ the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ vocative. ﴿أَبانَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the Five Nouns, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿اسْتَغْفِرْ﴾ an imperative verb, jussive (majzūm), its fāʿil latent. ﴿لَنا﴾ the two are attached to استغفر. ﴿ذُنُوبَنا﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ إنّ and its noun; the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīliyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ كان and its noun; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿خاطِئِينَ﴾ the khabar of كنا, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:98-99.t: ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿سَوْفَ﴾ a particle of deferment (taswīf). ﴿أَسْتَغْفِرُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أستغفر. ﴿رَبِّي﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism); its clause is the object of the saying. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), or a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. ﴿الْغَفُورُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of هو; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿الرَّحِيمُ﴾ a second khabar, nominative. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿لما﴾ temporal (ḥīniyya, "when"), an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿دَخَلُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى يُوسُفَ﴾ على is a preposition, and يوسف is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote (mamnūʿ min al-ṣarf); the two are attached to دخلوا. ﴿آوى﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause has no grammatical position because it is the response to the temporal لمّا. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to آوى. ﴿أَبَوَيْهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a dual, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿ادْخُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿مِصْرَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle governing the jussive. ﴿شاءَ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted; the clause is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya) with no grammatical position. ﴿آمِنِينَ﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:100-100.t: ﴿وَرَفَعَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and رفع is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir). ﴿أَبَوَيْهِ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ because it is a dual, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded. ﴿عَلَى الْعَرْشِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) رفع. ﴿وَخَرُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿لَهُ﴾ the two are attached to خروا. ﴿سُجَّداً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿قالَ﴾ the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يا﴾ for the vocative. ﴿أَبَتِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative because it is annexed to the omitted first-person yāʾ. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿تَأْوِيلُ﴾ khabar (predicate); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl), as is the vocative clause. ﴿رُءْيايَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the kasra implied (muqaddara) on the alif owing to impossibility (al-taʿadhdhur), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿جَعَلَها رَبِّي﴾ a past verb, its mafʿūl and its fāʿil placed after, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿حَقًّا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), or a ḥāl; the clause is a ḥāl of رؤياي. ﴿وَقَدْ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl, and قد is a particle of realisation. ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent, referring back to ربي; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿بِي﴾ the two are attached to أحسن. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to what precedes it. ﴿أَخْرَجَنِي﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl, its fāʿil latent; the clause is muḍāf ilayhi to إذ. ﴿مِنَ السِّجْنِ﴾ the two are attached to أخرجني. ﴿وَجاءَ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil latent; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِكُمْ﴾ the two are attached to جاء. ﴿مِنَ الْبَدْوِ﴾ the two are attached to جاء. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar-forming particle (ḥarf maṣdarī). ﴿نَزَغَ الشَّيْطانُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is annexed to بعد. ﴿بَيْنِي﴾ an adverb of place (ẓarf makān), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَبَيْنَ﴾ conjoined to بيني. ﴿إِخْوَتِي﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي﴾ إنّ and its noun (ism), and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَطِيفٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is the object of the saying. ﴿لِما﴾ ما is a relative; the two are attached to لطيف. ﴿يَشاءُ﴾ the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) or mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿الْحَكِيمُ﴾ a second khabar; or the two are khabars of إنّ if the pronoun هو is a separating pronoun.

daas-irab:101-101.t: ﴿رَبِّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā) with an omitted vocative particle, accusative (manṣūb) because it is annexed to the omitted first-person yāʾ; the omitted yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the vocative clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿آتَيْتَنِي﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya). ﴿مِنَ الْمُلْكِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) آتيتني. ﴿وَعَلَّمْتَنِي﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the nūn is for protection; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ﴾ the two are attached to علمتني. ﴿الْأَحادِيثِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فاطِرَ﴾ the one addressed with an omitted vocative particle, accusative. ﴿السَّماواتِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السماوات. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ a detached pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَلِيِّي﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel suited [to the yāʾ]. ﴿فِي الدُّنْيا﴾ the two are attached to وليي or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَالْآخِرَةِ﴾ conjoined to الدنيا. ﴿تَوَفَّنِي﴾ a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ), indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the weak letter; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿مُسْلِماً﴾ ḥāl, accusative. ﴿وَأَلْحِقْنِي﴾ a verb of supplication, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), its implied form being "أنت"; the nūn is for protection and the yāʾ is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿بِالصَّالِحِينَ﴾ الصالحين is genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the two are attached to ألحقني.

daas-irab:102-105.t: ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿مِنْ أَنْباءِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). ﴿الْغَيْبِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya). ﴿نُوحِيهِ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl (object), its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir); the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ the two are attached to نوحيه. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ كان and its noun (ism). ﴿لَدَيْهِمْ﴾ لدى is an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to an omitted khabar of كان; the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi and the mīm is for the plural; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿أَجْمَعُوا أَمْرَهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl; the clause is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَمْكُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is the khabar, and the clause of mubtadaʾ and khabar is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and ما operates like ليس. ﴿أَكْثَرُ﴾ the noun of ليس. [Translator's note: i.e. the noun of ما, which operates like ليس.] ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and لو is a conditional particle not governing the jussive. ﴿حَرَصْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is parenthetical, between the noun of the Ḥijāzī ما and its khabar. ﴿بِمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); مؤمنين is khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position; the apodosis (jawāb) of لو is omitted, its implied form being "لم يؤمنوا" (they would not believe). ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿تَسْئَلُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its first mafʿūl, its fāʿil latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِ﴾ the two are attached to the verb. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a redundant preposition. ﴿أَجْرٍ﴾ second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), genitive in form and accusative in position; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾ negating. ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿ذِكْرٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿لِلْعالَمِينَ﴾ the two are attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of ذكر. ﴿وَكَأَيِّنْ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْ آيَةٍ﴾ مِن is a preposition, and آية is tamyīz (specification), genitive (majrūr). ﴿فِي السَّماواتِ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted adjective of آية. ﴿وَالْأَرْضِ﴾ conjoined to السماوات. ﴿يَمُرُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلَيْها﴾ the two are attached to يمرون. ﴿وَهُمْ عَنْها مُعْرِضُونَ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl, and mubtadaʾ and khabar; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar; the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:106-108.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa) to what preceded. ﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ; the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يؤمن. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl (circumstantial clause), and mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مُشْرِكُونَ﴾ khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ) by the wāw; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿أَفَأَمِنُوا﴾ the hamza is for disapproving interrogation (istifhām inkārī), the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is joined to the wāw of the group; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿أَنْ﴾ a particle governing the accusative (nāṣiba). ﴿تَأْتِيَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb); the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and the mīm is for the plural. ﴿غاشِيَةٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿مِنْ عَذابِ﴾ the two are attached to an adjective (ṣifa) of غاشية; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi of أمنوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿تَأْتِيَهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative because it is conjoined to an accusative; the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿السَّاعَةُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿بَغْتَةً﴾ ḥāl. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl and هم is mubtadaʾ. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, and the verbal clause is the khabar. ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive. ﴿هذِهِ﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (al-tanbīh), and ذه is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿سَبِيلِي﴾ khabar, nominative by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the first-person yāʾ, its appearance prevented by the place being occupied by the vowel suited [to the yāʾ]; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿أَدْعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma implied on the wāw owing to heaviness (al-thiqal), its fāʿil latent. ﴿إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, genitive by إلى; the two are attached to أدعو; the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿عَلى بَصِيرَةٍ﴾ the two are attached to أدعو. ﴿أَنَا﴾ tawkīd (emphasis) of the latent fāʿil of أدعو. ﴿وَمَنِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and مَن is a relative conjoined to the fāʿil of أدعو. ﴿اتَّبَعَنِي﴾ a past verb; the nūn is for protection (al-wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; the fāʿil is omitted; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَسُبْحانَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw introduces a ḥāl, and ما operates like ليس. ﴿أَنَا﴾ in the position of a nominative as the noun (ism) of ما. ﴿مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ﴾ attached to an omitted khabar of ما; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.

daas-irab:109-109.t: ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) and ما is negating. ﴿أَرْسَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِكَ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أرسلنا, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿رِجالًا﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿نُوحِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is an adjective (ṣifa) of رجالا. ﴿إِلَيْهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to نوحي. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِ﴾ the two are attached to a second adjective of رجالا. ﴿الْقُرى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَفَلَمْ﴾ the hamza is for interrogation, and لم is a particle of negation, of the jussive (jazm) and of conversion [of the imperfect to past meaning] (qalb). ﴿يَسِيرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ the two are attached to يسيروا. ﴿فَيَنْظُرُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and ينظروا is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to يسيروا, jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the clause is conjoined, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿كَيْفَ﴾ an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative as the khabar (predicate) of كان, placed first. ﴿كانَ عاقِبَةُ﴾ كان and its noun (ism); the clause is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi of ينظروا. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلَدارُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and دار is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الْآخِرَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿خَيْرٌ﴾ khabar; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿لِلَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun is genitive (majrūr); the two are attached to خير. ﴿اتَّقَوْا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila. ﴿أَفَلا﴾ the hamza is for interrogation and لا is negating. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is resumptive with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:110-111.t: ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit (ghāya). ﴿إِذَا﴾ an adverb containing the sense of condition. ﴿اسْتَيْأَسَ الرُّسُلُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of a genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَظَنُّوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūfa). ﴿أَنَّهُمْ﴾ أنّ and its noun (ism); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) stands in place of the two objects of ظنّ. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). كذبوا is a passive past verb (mabnī lil-majhūl), and the wāw is nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is the khabar (predicate) of أنهم. ﴿جاءَهُمْ نَصْرُنا﴾ a past verb, its mafʿūl (object) placed first and its fāʿil placed after, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of the genitive construct); the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a condition that does not govern the jussive. ﴿فَنُجِّيَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and نجي is a passive past verb. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative, nāʾib fāʿil. ﴿نَشاءُ﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and لا is negating. ﴿يُرَدُّ بَأْسُنا﴾ an imperfect passive verb and its nāʾib fāʿil, and نا is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined. ﴿عَنِ الْقَوْمِ﴾ the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) يرد. ﴿الْمُجْرِمِينَ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ. ﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām occurs in the response to an omitted oath, and قد is a particle of realisation. ﴿كانَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿فِي قَصَصِهِمْ﴾ the two are attached to a khabar placed first, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِبْرَةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject) placed after. [Translator's note: so in the source; with كان, عبرة is the noun of كان placed after.] ﴿لِأُولِي﴾ أولي is genitive by the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural; the two are attached to an omitted adjective of عبرة. ﴿الْأَلْبابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause has no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿كانَ حَدِيثاً﴾ كان and its khabar; its noun is omitted, its implied form being "هو", i.e. the Noble Quran; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يُفْتَرى﴾ an imperfect passive verb; the nāʾib fāʿil is omitted; the clause is an adjective of حديثا. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk). ﴿تَصْدِيقَ﴾ the khabar of a كان omitted together with its noun. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). [Translator's note: so in the source; بين here is usually treated as an adverb of place.] ﴿يَدَيْهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ because it is a dual, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَفْصِيلَ﴾ conjoined to تصديق. ﴿كُلِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَهُدىً﴾ conjoined to تصديق and accusative (manṣūb) like it. ﴿وَرَحْمَةً﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿لِقَوْمٍ﴾ the two are attached to رحمة. ﴿يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is an adjective of قوم.

daas-irab:1-4.t:
﴿الر﴾ the openings of the surahs are letters that have no i'rab. ﴿تِلْكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿آياتُ﴾ khabar (predicate), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الْكِتابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿الْمُبِينِ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿أَنْزَلْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿قُرْآناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi, or ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَرَبِيًّا﴾ an adjective, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ laʿalla and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿تَعْقِلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar.

﴿نَحْنُ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and its clause is resumptive. ﴿نَقُصُّ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) نقص. ﴿أَحْسَنَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْقَصَصِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is maṣdariyya (infinitival); it and what follows it are in the position of the genitive, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to نقص. ﴿أَوْحَيْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿إِلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوحينا. ﴿هذَا﴾ ذا is a demonstrative, mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh). ﴿الْقُرْآنَ﴾ badal (substitute) of the demonstrative. ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and in is lightened from the heavy inna, its noun being the pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn), and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿كُنْتَ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is the khabar of in. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَمِنَ الْغافِلِينَ﴾ the distinguishing lām (al-lām al-fāriqa), and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar of kāna.

﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time containing the sense of condition, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "اذكر". ﴿قالَ يُوسُفُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لِأَبِيهِ﴾ the lām is a preposition and أبيه is a noun genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, attached to قال. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَبَتِ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) because it is annexed to the dropped yāʾ of the speaker; the sign of its accusative is an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, its appearance prevented by suitability to the dropped letter, and the tāʾ has been substituted for the dropped yāʾ; and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿رَأَيْتُ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَحَدَ عَشَرَ﴾ two words indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa of both parts, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿كَوْكَباً﴾ tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَالشَّمْسَ﴾ conjoined to أحد عشر. ﴿وَالْقَمَرَ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿رَأَيْتُهُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ساجدين. ﴿ساجِدِينَ﴾ the second mafʿūl bihi of رأيتهم.

daas-irab:5-6.t:
﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿بُنَيَّ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿لا تَقْصُصْ﴾ lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿رُؤْياكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative with an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عَلى إِخْوَتِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) تقصص, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَيَكِيدُوا﴾ the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation (al-sababiyya), and an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied an after the fāʾ of causation, and the wāw is fāʿil. ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يكيدوا. ﴿كَيْداً﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿إِنَّ الشَّيْطانَ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿لِلْإِنْسانِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عدو. ﴿عَدُوٌّ﴾ khabar (predicate). ﴿مُبِينٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the kāf is a preposition, and ذا is a demonstrative, genitive by the kāf; the lām is for distance and the [second] kāf for address; and the two [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿يَجْتَبِيكَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾ fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَيُعَلِّمُكَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يعلمك. ﴿الْأَحادِيثِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative and its mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿عَلَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يتم. ﴿وَعَلى آلِ﴾ conjoined to what precedes it. ﴿يَعْقُوبَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿كَما﴾ the kāf is a preposition and mā is maṣdariyya (infinitival). ﴿أَتَمَّها﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil; mā and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are in the position of the genitive by the kāf, and [the preposition and its genitive noun] are attached to an adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿عَلى أَبَوَيْكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أتمها, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ قبل is genitive by min, and it is indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِبْراهِيمَ﴾ badal (substitute) of أبويك. ﴿وَإِسْحاقَ﴾ conjoined to إبراهيم. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its two khabars.

daas-irab:7-10.t:
﴿لَقَدْ﴾ the lām is the lām of the oath and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿كانَ فِي يُوسُفَ﴾ kāna, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate), and يوسف is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿وَإِخْوَتِهِ﴾ conjoined to يوسف, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿آياتٌ﴾ the noun of kāna, and the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿لِلسَّائِلِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of آيات.

﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb of time attached to the omitted verb اذكر. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَيُوسُفُ﴾ the lām is the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ), and يوسف is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿وَإِخْوَتِهِ﴾ conjoined to يوسف, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿وَإِخْوَتِهِ﴾ again here; the word in this verse is وَأَخُوهُ]. ﴿أَحَبُّ﴾ khabar, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿إِلى﴾ a preposition. ﴿أَبِينا﴾ genitive by ilā, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أحب. ﴿وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿أَبانا﴾ the noun of inna, accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the five nouns, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَفِي ضَلالٍ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective of ضلال, and the clause is in the position of the accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.

﴿اقْتُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil. ﴿يُوسُفَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl of an omitted verb, its implied form being "قال قائل منهم اقتلوا". ﴿أَوِ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿اطْرَحُوهُ﴾ an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَرْضاً﴾ an adverb of place, or a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿يَخْلُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يخل. ﴿وَجْهُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿أَبِيكُمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَتَكُونُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb conjoined to يخل and jussive like it, by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿مِنْ بَعْدِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to صالحين, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَوْماً﴾ khabar. ﴿صالِحِينَ﴾ an adjective, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

﴿قالَ قائِلٌ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قائل. ﴿لا تَقْتُلُوا يُوسُفَ﴾ lā is prohibitive, and an imperfect verb in the jussive by the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is fāʿil and يوسف is its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَأَلْقُوهُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فِي غَيابَتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ألقوه. ﴿الْجُبِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَلْتَقِطْهُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive because it is the answer to the request, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَعْضُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿السَّيَّارَةِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ فاعِلِينَ﴾ kāna, its noun and its khabar, and the clause is initial because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

daas-irab:11-14.t:
﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَبانا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the five nouns, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ما لَكَ﴾ mā is an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لا تَأْمَنَّا﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the nūn that is assimilated into nā, and nā is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿عَلى يُوسُفَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تأمنا. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and inna and its noun. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to ناصحون. ﴿لَناصِحُونَ﴾ the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), and the khabar of inna, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿أَرْسِلْهُ﴾ an imperative verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَعَنا﴾ an adverb of place attached to أرسله, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَرْتَعْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) because it is the answer to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), with a latent fāʿil. ﴿وَيَلْعَبْ﴾ an imperfect verb conjoined to يرتع, and parsed like it. ﴿وَإِنَّا﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and inna and its noun. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حافظون. ﴿لَحافِظُونَ﴾ the shifted lām, and the khabar of inna, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural.

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿إِنِّي﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَيَحْزُنُنِي﴾ the shifted lām, and an imperfect verb; the nūn is for protection (wiqāya) and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿تَذْهَبُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil; an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of يحزنني. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تذهبوا. ﴿وَأَخافُ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperfect verb in the nominative with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿يَأْكُلَهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الذِّئْبُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ غافِلُونَ﴾ mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl, and عنه is attached to غافلون.

﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَئِنْ﴾ the lām paves the way for the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam), and in is conditional. ﴿أَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ﴾ a past verb, its postponed fāʿil and its fronted mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is initial. ﴿وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿إِذاً﴾ a particle of response. ﴿لَخاسِرُونَ﴾ the shifted lām, and خاسرون is khabar, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is the answer to the oath, with no grammatical position, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted.

daas-irab:15-17.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is conditional, an adverb of time. ﴿ذَهَبُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) ذهبوا. ﴿وَأَجْمَعُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿يَجْعَلُوهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by an, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فِي غَيابَتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to يجعلوا. ﴿الْجُبِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَأَوْحَيْنا﴾ the wāw is redundant (zāʾida), and a past verb, and nā is its fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿إِلَيْهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أوحينا. ﴿لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُمْ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بِأَمْرِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تنبئنهم, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive, an adjective (ṣifa) of أمرهم. ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and هم is mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يَشْعُرُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar (predicate).

﴿وَجاؤُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿أَباهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the alif because it is one of the five nouns, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿عِشاءً﴾ an adverb of time attached to جاءوا. ﴿يَبْكُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿قالُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿أَبانا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), accusative by the alif because it is one of the five nouns, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna, and nā is its noun; the clause and the one before it are the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿ذَهَبْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar of إنا. ﴿نَسْتَبِقُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَتَرَكْنا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿يُوسُفَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place attached to تركنا. ﴿مَتاعِنا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and nā is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿فَأَكَلَهُ الذِّئْبُ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fronted mafʿūl bihi and its postponed fāʿil. ﴿وَما﴾ the wāw is circumstantial, and mā is negating, operating like laysa. ﴿أَنْتَ﴾ the noun of mā. ﴿بِمُؤْمِنٍ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant, and مؤمن is the khabar, genitive in form and accusative in position. ﴿لَنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مؤمن, and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial and law is redundant. ﴿كُنَّا﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿صادِقِينَ﴾ khabar, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is a ḥāl.

daas-irab:18-20.t:
﴿وَجاؤُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى قَمِيصِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), the implied form being "وجاؤوا بدم كذب ملقى على قميصه", and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِدَمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جاءوا. ﴿كَذِبٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa) of دم. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil. ﴿بَلْ﴾ a particle of digression (iḍrāb). ﴿سَوَّلَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to سولت. ﴿أَنْفُسُكُمْ﴾ fāʿil, and the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿أَمْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and صبر is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "شأني صبر"; جميل is an adjective, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعانُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and mubtadaʾ and khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى ما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مستعان. ﴿تَصِفُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

﴿وَجاءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَأَرْسَلُوا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿وارِدَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿فَأَدْلى﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿دَلْوَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿يا﴾ a vocative particle. ﴿بُشْرى﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, with an implied fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility [Translator's note: so in the source, which mixes two analyses; يا بشرى (or بشراي) is usually parsed as a muḍāf munādā, accusative with an implied fatḥa]. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ. ﴿غُلامٌ﴾ khabar; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضاعَةً﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its two objects, and the clause is maʿṭūf [Translator's note: so in the source; بضاعة is more commonly parsed as a ḥāl]. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ and عليم is khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِما﴾ mā is relative; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to عليم. ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila.

﴿وَشَرَوْهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِثَمَنٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to شروه. ﴿بَخْسٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: so in the source; بخسٍ is an adjective of ثمن, since the construction is not one of annexation]. ﴿دَراهِمَ﴾ badal (substitute) of ثمن, genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿مَعْدُودَةٍ﴾ an adjective of دراهم, genitive like it. ﴿وَكانُوا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and kāna and its noun, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to الزاهدين. ﴿مِنَ الزَّاهِدِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar.

daas-irab:21-22.t:
﴿وَقالَ الَّذِي﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb, and the relative noun is its fāʿil (agent), and the clause is resumptive. ﴿اشْتَراهُ﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿مِنْ مِصْرَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), and مصر is genitive (majrūr) by the fatḥa because it is a diptote. ﴿لِامْرَأَتِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قال, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿أَكْرِمِي﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the yāʾ is fāʿil. ﴿مَثْواهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿عَسى﴾ a past verb, one of the verbs of hope (rajāʾ), its noun omitted. ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿يَنْفَعَنا﴾ an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb); nā is mafʿūl bihi and its fāʿil is latent; an and what follows it are in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of ʿasā. ﴿أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُ﴾ conjoined to ينفعنا, and parsed like it. ﴿وَلَداً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi.

﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the kāf is a preposition and ذا is a demonstrative, and the two are attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the lām is for distance; the kāf is a preposition and ذا is a demonstrative, and the two are attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq, and the lām is for distance and the kāf for address [Translator's note: the source repeats this sentence]. ﴿مَكَّنَّا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿لِيُوسُفَ﴾ يوسف is a diptote, genitive by the fatḥa; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مكنا. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to مكنا, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُ﴾ the wāw is redundant (zāʾida), and the lām is the lām of causation (taʿlīl), and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent; the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are attached to مكنا. ﴿مِنْ تَأْوِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نعلمه. ﴿الْأَحادِيثِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ غالِبٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and غالب is its khabar, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَلى أَمْرِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to غالب, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَلكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and lākinna and its noun, and the clause is conjoined to what precedes. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لا يَعْلَمُونَ﴾ lā is negating, and an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar.

﴿وَلَمَّا﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time containing the sense of condition. ﴿بَلَغَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿أَشُدَّهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿آتَيْناهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its first mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿حُكْماً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَعِلْماً﴾ conjoined to حكما. ﴿وَكَذلِكَ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the kāf is a preposition, and the demonstrative is in the position of the genitive; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq. ﴿نَجْزِي﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the yāʾ owing to heaviness (thiql), with a latent fāʿil. ﴿الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural.

daas-irab:23-24.t:
﴿وَراوَدَتْهُ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the tāʾ is for the feminine, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿الَّتِي﴾ a relative noun, fāʿil (agent). ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿فِي بَيْتِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) with no grammatical position. ﴿وَغَلَّقَتِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿الْأَبْوابَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿هَيْتَ﴾ a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr), its fāʿil latent. ﴿لَكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to هيت, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَعاذَ﴾ mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّهُ رَبِّي﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿أَحْسَنَ مَثْوايَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and مثواي is mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the letter before the yāʾ of the speaker, and the yāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is in the position of the nominative as the second khabar of inna. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ negating. ﴿يُفْلِحُ الظَّالِمُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, nominative by the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural, and the clause is the khabar of إنه.

﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a particle of the genitive and of oath, the lām occurs in the answer to an omitted oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿هَمَّتْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and its fāʿil is latent, and the oath clause has no grammatical position. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to همت. ﴿وَهَمَّ بِها﴾ conjoined to همت به. ﴿لَوْلا﴾ a non-jussive-governing conditional particle. ﴿أَنْ﴾ an accusative-governing particle. ﴿رَأى﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil. ﴿بُرْهانَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿رَبِّهِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause made of an and the verb, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "رؤية", and its khabar is omitted. ﴿كَذلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq; the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿لِنَصْرِفَ﴾ the lām is for causation (taʿlīl), and an imperfect verb in the accusative by an implied an after the lām of causation; the lām and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar, are attached to what كذلك is attached to. ﴿عَنْهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نصرف. ﴿السُّوءَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَالْفَحْشاءَ﴾ conjoined to السوء. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun. ﴿مِنْ عِبادِنَا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿الْمُخْلَصِينَ﴾ an adjective of عبادنا.

daas-irab:25-26.t:
﴿وَاسْتَبَقَا الْبابَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the alif is its fāʿil (agent) and الباب its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿وَقَدَّتْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir), and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿قَمِيصَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿مِنْ دُبُرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) قدت. ﴿وَأَلْفَيا﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿سَيِّدَها﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿لَدَى﴾ an adverb of place attached to ألفيا. ﴿الْبابَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قالَتْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿ما﴾ negating. ﴿جَزاءُ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنْ﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿مِنْ﴾; the word in the verse is مَنْ]. ﴿أَرادَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿بِأَهْلِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أراد. ﴿سُوءاً﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿أَنْ﴾ accusative-governing. ﴿يُسْجَنَ﴾ a passive imperfect verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is latent; an and what follows it, interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun), are in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of جزاء. ﴿أَوْ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿عَذابٌ﴾ conjoined to the khabar. ﴿أَلِيمٌ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿هِيَ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and its clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿راوَدَتْنِي﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine, the nūn is for protection (wiqāya), the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَنْ نَفْسِي﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to راودتني. ﴿وَشَهِدَ شاهِدٌ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿مِنْ أَهْلِها﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an adjective of شاهد, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿إِنْ﴾ conditional. ﴿كانَ قَمِيصُهُ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿قُدَّ﴾ a passive past verb, and the fāʿil is latent [Translator's note: so in the source; with a passive verb this is the nāʾib fāʿil], and the clause is the khabar of kāna. ﴿مِنْ قُبُلٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قدّ. ﴿فَصَدَقَتْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿هُوَ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿مِنَ الْكاذِبِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:27-30.t:
﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and in is conditional, and its clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿كانَ قَمِيصُهُ﴾ kāna and its noun, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the clause is initial. ﴿قُدَّ﴾ a passive past verb, and the clause is the khabar (predicate). ﴿مِنْ دُبُرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) قدّ. ﴿فَكَذَبَتْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَهُوَ﴾ the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and هو is mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ الصَّادِقِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and lammā al-ḥīniyya ("when") is an adverb of time attached to قال. ﴿رَأى﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied (muqaddar) fatḥa on the alif owing to impossibility (taʿadhdhur), and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قَمِيصَهُ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿قُدَّ﴾ a passive past verb, its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent. ﴿مِنْ دُبُرٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قدّ. ﴿قالَ﴾ a past verb with a latent fāʿil, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition. ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿مِنْ كَيْدِكُنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar; the kāf is muḍāf ilayhi and the nūn is the sign of the feminine plural. ﴿إِنَّ كَيْدَكُنَّ عَظِيمٌ﴾ inna, its noun and its khabar; the kāf and the nūn have been parsed above, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿يُوسُفُ﴾ the one addressed (munādā), with an omitted vocative particle; it is indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative by the vocative. ﴿أَعْرِضْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَنْ هذا﴾ ذا is a demonstrative in the position of the genitive; a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعرض; the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl of an omitted verb, its implied form being "قال يوسف …" etc. ﴿وَاسْتَغْفِرِي﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and an imperative verb, and the yāʾ is fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿لِذَنْبِكِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to استغفري. ﴿إِنَّكِ﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) with no grammatical position. ﴿كُنْتِ﴾ kāna and its noun. ﴿مِنَ الْخاطِئِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the khabar, and the clause is the khabar of إنك.

﴿وَقالَ نِسْوَةٌ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, and a past verb and its fāʿil, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي الْمَدِينَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to قال. ﴿امْرَأَتُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿الْعَزِيزِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿تُراوِدُ﴾ an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ) with a latent fāʿil. ﴿فَتاها﴾ mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) with an implied fatḥa on the alif, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿عَنْ نَفْسِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to تراود. ﴿قَدْ﴾ a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿شَغَفَها﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is latent. ﴿حُبًّا﴾ tamyīz (specification), and the clause is a ḥāl. ﴿إِنَّا﴾ inna and its noun, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl. ﴿لَنَراها﴾ an imperfect verb and its mafʿūl bihi, with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is the khabar. ﴿فِي ضَلالٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to نراها. ﴿مُبِينٍ﴾ an adjective (ṣifa).

daas-irab:31-32.t:
﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is resumptive, and lammā is ḥīniyya ("when"), an adverb of time. ﴿سَمِعَتْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بِمَكْرِهِنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to (mutaʿalliq) سمعت, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَرْسَلَتْ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿إِلَيْهِنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أرسلت. ﴿وَأَعْتَدَتْ﴾ conjoined to أرسلت. ﴿لَهُنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to أعتدت. ﴿مُتَّكَأً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَآتَتْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and the fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf (conjoined). ﴿كُلَّ﴾ first mafʿūl bihi. ﴿واحِدَةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿مِنْهُنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa). ﴿سِكِّيناً﴾ second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقالَتِ﴾ conjoined to آتت. ﴿اخْرُجْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿عَلَيْهِنَّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to اخرج.

﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and lammā al-ḥīniyya. ﴿رَأَيْنَهُ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural; the nūn is fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿أَكْبَرْنَهُ﴾ parsed like رأينه: a past verb, the nūn is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَقَطَّعْنَ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and a past verb, and the nūn of the feminine plural is fāʿil. ﴿أَيْدِيَهُنَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَقُلْنَ﴾ a past verb, and the nūn is its fāʿil, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿حاشَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to حاش. ﴿ما هذا﴾ mā is negating, operating like laysa, and the demonstrative is its noun. ﴿بَشَراً﴾ its khabar (predicate); the clause, together with what precedes it, is the maqūl al-qawl (object of the speech verb). ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle of negation. ﴿هذا﴾ the hāʾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr). ﴿مَلَكٌ﴾ khabar. ﴿كَرِيمٌ﴾ an adjective of ملك, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl.

﴿قالَتْ﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is for the feminine and its fāʿil is latent, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فَذلِكُنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), and ذا is a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ; the lām is for distance, the kāf for address, and the doubled nūn is the sign of the feminine plural. ﴿الَّذِي﴾ a relative noun, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هو الذي", and the clause is the khabar of ذا. ﴿لُمْتُنَّنِي﴾ a past verb; the tāʾ is its fāʿil, the doubled nūn is the sign of the feminine plural, the [next] nūn is for protection (wiqāya), and the yāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause). ﴿فِيهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to لمتنني. ﴿وَلَقَدْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and qad is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿راوَدْتُهُ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to the oath. ﴿عَنْ نَفْسِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to راودته. ﴿فَاسْتَعْصَمَ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb whose fāʿil is latent, and the clause is maʿṭūf. ﴿وَلَئِنْ﴾ the wāw is resumptive, the lām occurs in the answer to an oath [Translator's note: so in the source; this lām is usually called the lām that paves the way for the oath (al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam)], and in is conditional. ﴿لَمْ﴾ jussive-governing. ﴿يَفْعَلْ﴾ an imperfect verb in the jussive (majzūm) with a latent fāʿil, and the clause is initial, with no grammatical position. ﴿ما﴾ relative, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿آمُرُهُ﴾ an imperfect verb with a latent fāʿil, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila. ﴿به﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to آمره. ﴿لَيُسْجَنَنَّ﴾ the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and a passive imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the clause has no grammatical position because it is the answer to an oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted. ﴿وَلَيَكُوناً﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, the lām occurs in the answer to the oath, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the light nūn of emphasis, its noun omitted. ﴿مِنَ الصَّاغِرِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun attached to the omitted khabar, and the clause is maʿṭūf.

farraa:88-88.t: His saying: ﴿وَجِئْنَا بِبِضَاعَةٍ مُّزْجَاةٍ﴾ ("and we have come with goods of little value"). They mentioned that they came to Egypt with goods, which they sold for dirhams that would not pass in buying food except at a rate other than that of good coins; so they asked Yūsuf to take them from them without giving them less. That is His saying: ﴿ فَأَوْفِ لَنَا ٱلْكَيْلَ وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيْنَآ﴾ ("so give us full measure and be charitable to us") — with the difference between the two rates.

farraa:93-94.t:
His saying: ﴿يَأْتِ بَصِيراً﴾ means: he will become seeing again.
His saying: ﴿لَوْلاَ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ﴾ He is saying: [were it not that] you call me a liar, call me incapable and call me weak [of mind].

farraa:98-98.t: His saying: ﴿سَوْفَ أَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكُمْ رَبِّيۤ﴾ ("I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord"). He said: al-Farrāʾ narrated to us (from) Sharīk, from al-Suddī, concerning this verse: he put them off until the pre-dawn hour (saḥar). (Abū Zakariyyā said: and Ḥibbān added for us, from al-Kalbī, from Abū Ṣāliḥ, from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said: he put them off until the pre-dawn hour) of the night before Friday.

farraa:105-105.t: His saying: ﴿وَكَأَيِّن مِّن آيَةٍ فِي ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ﴾ ("and how many a sign in the heavens and the earth"). The signs of the heavens are the sun, the moon and the stars; and the signs of the earth are the mountains, the rivers and the like.

farraa:106-106.t: His saying: ﴿وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِٱللَّهِ إِلاَّ وَهُمْ مُّشْرِكُونَ﴾ ("and most of them do not believe in Allah except while associating others with Him"). He is saying: if you ask them, "Who created you?" they say, "Allah"; or "Who provides for you?" they say, "Allah"; yet they associate others with Him and worship idols. That is His saying: ﴿وَمَا يُؤْمِنُ أَكْثَرُهُمْ بِٱللَّهِ إِلاَّ وَهُمْ مُّشْرِكُونَ﴾.

farraa:108-108.t: His saying: ﴿أَنَاْ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِي﴾ He is saying: I and whoever follows me — he too calls with clear insight, just as I call.

farraa:109-109.t:
His saying: ﴿وَلَدَارُ ٱلآخِرَةِ﴾ ("and the abode of the Hereafter"). "Abode" (al-dār) is put in iḍāfa (genitive construct) to "the Hereafter" (al-ākhira) although it is itself the Hereafter; the Arabs sometimes annex a thing to itself when its wording differs, as in His saying: ﴿إِنَّ هَذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ اليَقِينِ﴾ ("this is indeed the truth of certainty"), where the truth is the certainty. Similar to it is: "I came to you on the night (bāriḥa) of the first", "the year of the first", "the night of the first", and "the day of Thursday". All the days are annexed to themselves because their wording differs; likewise "the month of Rabīʿ". And the Arabs say in their speech — one of them recited to me:

أَتمدح فَقْعَساً وتذمّ عَبْساً * أَلا للهِ أُمُّك من هَجِين
ولو أقوت عَليك ديار عَبْس * عرفتَ الذُلَّ عِرفان اليقين
(Do you praise Faqʿas and blame ʿAbs? — By God, what a base-born one you are! / Had the dwellings of ʿAbs become empty for you, you would have known humiliation with the knowledge of certainty.)

Its meaning is only: a knowing and a certainty.

farraa:110-110.t:
His saying: ﴿حَتَّىٰ إِذَا ٱسْتَيْأَسَ ٱلرُّسُلُ وَظَنُّوۤاْ أَنَّهُمْ قَدْ كُذِبُواْ﴾ — light (without doubling). The people of Medina read it with doubling (kudhdhibū), and Ibn ʿAbbās read it light and explained it: until, when the messengers despaired of their people believing, and their people thought that the messengers had been lied to, Our help came to them. And (كُذِّبُوا) with doubling is reported from ʿAbdullāh [Ibn Masʿūd].

His saying: ﴿فَنَجى مَنْ نَشَاء﴾ — the reading is with two nūns, while the written text (the muṣḥaf) has come with one nūn. ʿĀṣim read (فَنُجِّيَ مَن نَّشَآءُ), making it a single nūn, as though he disliked adding a nūn; (مَنْ) is then in the position of the nominative. As for those who read it with two nūns, the second nūn is concealed (ikhfāʾ) and does not issue from a place other than that of the first; so when it was concealed it was dropped [in writing] — do you not see that you do not say fanunjī with the nūn pronounced distinctly? So when the second was concealed it was dropped and the first nūn sufficed for it, just as one letter of two suffices, so that it is assimilated and the two are written as one.

farraa:111-111.t: His saying: ﴿مَا كَانَ حَدِيثاً يُفْتَرَىٰ وَلَـٰكِن تَصْدِيقَ﴾ — [تصديق is] accusative (manṣūb), meaning: but it was a confirmation of what came before it of the Scriptures: the Torah and the Gospel. Had you made التصديق nominative it would be correct, as you say: "This was not standing but sitting (qāʿidan)" and "sitting (qāʿidun)". Likewise His saying: ﴿مَا كانَ مُحمَّدٌ أَبَا أَحَدٍ مِنْ رِجَالِكُم وَلَكِنْ رَسُولَ اللهِ﴾ ("Muḥammad is not the father of any of your men, but the Messenger of Allah") and ﴿رَسُولُ اللهِ﴾ [in the nominative]: whoever reads it in the nominative does not imply kāna; he means: but he is the Messenger of Allah.

farraa:3-3.t: The saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: ﴿بِمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ﴾. (هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْآنَ) is accusative (manṣūb) by the verb falling upon it, as though you said: "by Our revealing to you this Qur'an." Had you put (هذا) and (القرآنَ) in the genitive (khafḍ), it would be correct: you make (هذا) a repetition of (ما), as you say: «مررت بما عندك متاعِك» ("I passed by what you have — your goods"), making «المتاع» refer back to (مَا). Like it in al-Naḥl: ﴿وَلاَ تَقُولُوا لِمَا تَصِفُ ألْسِنَتِكُمْ الكَذِبَ﴾, and (الكَذِبِ) [in the genitive] on that basis.

farraa:4-5.t:
His saying: ﴿يا أبَتِ﴾: do not pause on it with hāʾ while you give it kasra in continuous recitation, because that kasra indicates annexation to the speaker. Were a reader to read (يا أَبَتُ), it would be permissible (and pausing on the hāʾ would be permissible), but no one we know has read it so. Were it said (يا أبَتَ), pausing on it (with hāʾ) would be permissible in one respect and not permissible in another. As for the permissibility of pausing on the hāʾ, it is that you make the fatḥa in it a fatḥa of the vocative and do not intend to join it to the alif of lamentation (alif al-nudba); so it is like the saying of the poet:
* كِلِينِى لِهَمٍّ يا أُميمةَ ناصبِ *
(Leave me, O Umayma, to a wearying care.)
As for the respect in which pausing on the hāʾ is not permissible, it is that you intend «يا أبتاه», then drop the hāʾ and the alif; for in intention it is joined to the alif just as, in the genitive, it is joined to the speaker's yāʾ.
As for His saying: ﴿إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَباً﴾: the Arabs make the numbers from eleven to nineteen accusative [i.e. fixed with fatḥa] in their genitive and nominative. That is because they made two known nouns into one; they did not annex the first to the second, which would take it out of the meaning of number, nor did they put its last part in the nominative, which would make it like «بعلبكّ» when they put its end in the nominative. They allowed themselves to annex «بعل» to «بَكّ» because in this one part is not recognised as separable from the other; but the five is separable from the ten and the ten from the five, so they gave them a single i'rab, because their meaning originally is "ten and five." When the two were diverted from their proper way, they were given one inflection in declension, as their inflection had been one before they were diverted.
As for the accusative of «كوكب», it came out as a specification (mufassir) of the kind for every number, so that what you are speaking of may be known. In speech it is like your saying: «عندى كذا وكذا درهماً» ("I have so-and-so many dirhams"): «الدرهم» came out as a specification of «كذا وكذا», because it can apply to anything. If you bring the alif and lām into «أحد عشر», you bring them in at its beginning and say: «ما فعلت الخمسةَ عَشَرَ؟» ("what did the fifteen do?"). It is also permissible to say «ما فعلت الخمسةَ العشرَ», bringing in the alif and lām twice, because they imagine the one as separable from the other in a certain state. But if you say «الخمسة العشرِ» [annexing], it is not permissible, because the first is other than the second; do you not see that in their saying «ما فعلت الخمسةُ الأثوابِ» — for whoever permits it — you find that the five are the garments, but you do not find the ten to be the five? That is why its annexation with alif and lām is not sound. If you wish, you may also bring the alif and lām into the dirham that comes out as a specification, and say: «ما فعلت الخمسة العشر الدرهم؟».
